✈️ TSA agents are working without pay. ICE agents are not.

Facing the highest call out rate in the nation, travelers at Houston airports face hours long TSA lines during the federal shutdown, Meanwhile, ICE agents deployed to assist at airports are still receiving pay due to a sweeping federal spending law. | Chron | Facebook
